name: Zipline
author: Elliot Moreau
description: Upload screenshots, screen recordings, files and the clipboard to your Zipline server and copy the link.

barWidget.description: Upload a region, window, full screen, the last screen recording, the clipboard or a file to Zipline. Right-click uploads a screenshot.

schema.label: Recent links shown
schema.description: How many recent uploads the panel lists. Server URL and token live in ~/.config/omarchy-zipline/config, never in shell.json.
